title: Bound on the mean-curvature term of a radial cutoff
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, μ a measure on ℝ^P (Euclid P), y ∈ ℝ^P, H : ℝ^P → ℝ^P, φ : ℝ → ℝ and κ, A, τ ∈ ℝ, with τ > 0, φ(u) ≥ 0 for every u, φ(u) = 0 for every u ≥ A, |H(x)| ≤ κ for every x, and x ↦ φ(|x − y|/τ) μ-integrable. Then |∫ φ(|x − y|/τ)·⟨x − y, H(x)⟩ dμ(x)| ≤ A·κ·τ·∫ φ(|x − y|/τ) dμ(x) (Bochner integrals).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (y : Euclid P) (H : Euclid P → Euclid P) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (κ A τ : ℝ), 0 < τ → (∀ u, 0 ≤ φ u) → (∀ u, A ≤ u → φ u = 0) → (∀ x, ‖H x‖ ≤ κ) → Integrable (fun x => φ (‖x - y‖ / τ)) μ → |∫ x, φ (‖x - y‖ / τ) * inner ℝ (x - y) (H x) ∂μ| ≤ A * κ * τ * ∫ x, φ (‖x - y‖ / τ) ∂μ
